_comment: Optional 3D models. Map a POS style_code to a public .glb/.gltf URL and clicking that product's photo on /stock opens an interactive 3D view (orbit + AR on mobile). Example: "VH-CS336A": "https://your-cdn.com/models/canvas-336a.glb". Keys must match Neon style_code (e.g. VH-EP10). Leave empty to show the large photo instead.
